narrative.title: The Datacenter Rack Allocation Sweep
narrative.scenario: A datacenter floor maps occupied racks as 1s and free bays as 0s. Facilities planning wants the largest rectangular block of contiguous free bays to reserve for a cooling unit. Scanning row by row, each row's free-bay heights form a skyline whose largest inscribed rectangle is measured with the histogram routine.
narrative.inputFormat: A binary matrix given as rows of 0/1 integers.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the area of the largest rectangle containing only 1s.

testCases.explanation: Rows 2-4, columns 3-5 form a 2x3 block of ones with area 6.
No free bay exists, so no rectangle can be reserved.
